subject: Aurum Health evidence request: SIG-lite + SCIM/SAML artifacts
messages:
From: Kari Olsen <kari@aurumhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial SIG-lite + SCIM/SAML ask for procurement

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Aurum Health’s procurement team needs a compact evidence package to close our security review for the pilot. We are focusing on access control / identity artifacts only (SIG-lite + CAIQ subset). Can you provide the following items by EOD Tuesday (2025-11-25)? If that is tight for you please propose an alternative: 

1) Completed SIG-lite spreadsheet (we flagged SSO/SCIM/RBAC questions)
2) SCIM delta samples (CSV) showing user create/update/delete events for last 30 days
3) Example SAML assertion samples (redacted) for a typical user + service account
4) Service-account ownership mapping (who owns each SA, justification, last-used timestamp)
5) Short note on least-privilege / role scoping approach and any automated checks

We will accept redacted data for PII but need clear mapping and timestamps for auditability. Also indicate any docs you prefer to provide via secure Drive link or DocuSign.

Cheers,
Kari Olsen
Security Manager, Aurum Health
security@aurumhealth.com

(Attachment: Aurum-SIG-checklist-v1.pdf)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Kari Olsen <kari@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG-lite + SCIM/SAML ask for procurement

Thanks Kari — appreciate the clarity.

We can assemble a SIG-lite answer sheet and the SCIM/SAML artifacts you requested. Quick notes:
- We will provide a filled SIG-lite spreadsheet and a short cover note explaining any control gaps and mitigations.
- SCIM delta samples: we will generate CSV extracts with sample records and timestamps; PII will be redacted.
- SAML assertions: we will include two examples (user and service account) with attribute mapping and issuer/audience fields.
- Service-account mapping: we will attach an owner roster and last-used timestamps.

Internal ask: Priyom, can you prepare the SCIM export and SA ownership CSV? Laura, can you pull two redacted SAML assertion examples and the SIG-lite answers? I will review and add the least-privilege summary.

Kari — is delivery via a shared Drive folder + zipped logs acceptable, or do you need DocuSign for the SIG-lite?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

(Attachments referenced: initial-request-Aurum.pdf)

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Kari Olsen <kari@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-22T10:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG-lite + SCIM/SAML ask for procurement

Putting together the extracts now. Delivery plan below: 

- SCIM delta samples: scim-delta-samples.csv (create/update/delete rows, timestamps in ISO8601, user_id pseudonymized).
- Service account owner mapping: sa-owner-mapping.csv (owner, team, last_used_iso).
- Access logs (token issuance + SSO events): access-logs-20251001-20251120.zip (log indices, redacted IPs).

I will drop the CSVs into a secure Drive folder and share the link with Kari after Rishi/Laura sign off. Expect drafts by EOD today (2025-11-22).

Laura — if you can confirm the SAML samples are ready, I will include them in the package. Also flag any fields that need manual redaction (email, user display name).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Access & Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

(Attachments: none yet)

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Kari Olsen <kari@aurumhealth.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-22T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG-lite + SCIM/SAML ask for procurement

Hi Kari — posting the artifacts to the Drive link now. Summary of what’s in the folder: 

1) SIG-lite-answers-v1.xlsx — completed answers for access-control related sections, with notes where evidence is operational (logs/exports).
2) scim-delta-samples.csv — three days of deltas, pseudonymized user_ids, create/update/delete flags.
3) saml-assertion-examples.txt — two assertion files (redacted Subject/NameID and email).
4) sa-owner-mapping.csv — service-account owner roster and last_used_iso.
5) access-logs-20251001-20251120.zip — zipped indexable logs with redactions.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/sig/aurum-2025 (shared with read-only expiring link, password-protected).

A couple of caveats: we replaced PII with stable pseudonyms and removed IP addresses per our data handling policy. If you need raw timestamps or unredacted samples for audit, we can arrange a secured transfer and an NDA addendum.

Rishi — I left inline comments in the SIG-lite sheet where we reference the logs. Priyom — please confirm the CSV schema and I’ll attach final copies here.

Kari — let me know if you want the SIG-lite signed and returned via DocuSign; otherwise the Drive package should be sufficient for procurement.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
(Attachments: SIG-lite-answers-v1.xlsx, scim-delta-samples.csv, saml-assertion-examples.txt, sa-owner-mapping.csv, access-logs-20251001-20251120.zip)
